title: Measured short RUP certificates for 2-CNF and renamable Horn
claims: MeasuredTwoSATRUPSearch produces a valid refutation of every unsatisfiable canonical width-two CNF using at most three learned clauses and twice the encoded input length plus six bits.
RUPPolarityInvariance proves that reversing fixed variable polarities preserves the pinned RUP relation.
MeasuredRenamableHornRUPSearch produces the single empty learned clause for any unsatisfiable canonical renamable Horn CNF, without computing a renaming.
RUPRunMonotone proves that adding original clauses preserves any already valid learned trace.
MeasuredBoundedRUPCheck verifies the exact refutation and the encoded length budget together.

experiments.purpose: Bind the archived Lean modules and exact statements to the recorded local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports zero Lean invocations and can be complemented by replay with the pinned reference.
